newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit closing for refuel.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit closing for refuel.

text.p: Arizona Public Service Co will shut unit 1 at the Palo Verde nuclear plant on Saturday for a scheduled 45-day refueling, a spokesman for the Pinnacle West subsidiary said Tuesday.
The 1,221-megawatt unit has begun to ramp down from full power and is now operating near 92 percent, added spokesman Jim MacDonald.
Palo Verde's other two nuclear units are operating normally, he said.

Pinnacle West has a 29.1 percent interest in the nuclear plant. Other owners include El Palo Electric, with a 15.8 percent stake, Enova Corp (15.8 percent) and Public Service of New Mexico (10.2 percent), with other local utilities owning the remainder.
